transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
My knees have been giving me a lot of trouble. I've had pain in both of them for several years now, but it's gotten much worse over the last few months.
When did you first notice it?
I've had it for several years now, so it came on gradually. It's really been the last few months that it's gotten much worse.
Is there anything that makes it better or worse?
The anti-inflammatory medicines I've taken and the injections I've had in my knees helped, but only temporarily. Nothing has given lasting relief.
How would you describe the feeling in your own words?
It's just pain in both knees, really. It's gotten to the point where it's affecting my daily activities.
Where exactly do you feel it, and does it spread anywhere?
It's in both knees, right on the knees themselves. I haven't noticed it spreading anywhere else.
On a scale from 0 to 10, where 10 is the worst, how bad is it?
I can't really put a number on it, I haven't thought of it that way. It's just gotten worse over the last few months and it's affecting what I can do day to day.
Is it there all the time, or does it come and go?
I'm not sure I can say precisely. It's just been getting worse over the last few months, and it's affecting what I can do day to day.
Has anything else been bothering you along with this?
No, nothing else in particular. It's really just the knees.
Do you see a doctor regularly for any health condition?
Not really — the knees are the main thing I've been treated for. I've taken anti-inflammatory medicines and had cortisone and Synvisc injections in them.
Which medicines do you take regularly, including any new ones?
Just anti-inflammatory medicines for the knees — I'm afraid I can't remember exactly which ones I was given. I've also had cortisone and Synvisc injections in the knees.
Are you allergic to any medicines?
No, I've never had any allergies to medicines that I know of.
Has this changed what you can do around the house or outside?
Yes, it has. The knee pain is affecting my daily activities, which is a big part of why I'm here.
Is there anything about this that worries you?
Yes — I want to know whether there's anything else that can be done, like surgery. And I'm concerned about the risks of infection and blood clots.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
